notes: Outbreak investigation of 23 ill persons (88% of 26 pool users) with descriptive proportions and medians; no tests, CIs or models. National context figures (987 outbreaks, 152 P. aeruginosa outbreaks, 66% in January–April) are cited from reference 5 and treated as external, not analysed here. [review] The pool-log shortfall (2 of 15 expected chlorine readings) is a compliance measure against a code requirement; a reader treating it as a fixed-referent comparison would restore comparison depth.
view_issues: Abstract gives 23 (66%) of 35 guests, but the text's denominator for the illness proportion is the 26 pool users (23 of 26, 88%).
